headlines.headline: NCAA TOURNAMENT TO EXPAND TO 76 TEAMS STARTING 2026-27
headlines.detail: The NCAA confirmed the men's basketball tournament will expand from 68 to 76 teams beginning with the 2026-27 season, with the same expansion applied to the women's tournament. In coaching news, Florida's Todd Golden signed a six-year, $49.5 million extension after last season's title run.

headlines.headline: 76ERS LAND LEBRON AND JAYLEN BROWN; GIANNIS HEADS TO MIAMI
headlines.detail: Philadelphia turned itself into a title contender this summer, keeping LeBron James and trading for Jaylen Brown, while Giannis Antetokounmpo signed with the Miami Heat to team up with Bam Adebayo. Golden State also re-signed Draymond Green to a one-year, $27.7 million deal as the league's superstar landscape reshapes ahead of training camp.

headlines.headline: AARON DONALD UN-RETIRES, SIGNS BACK WITH RAMS AS LEAGUE FINALIZES 53-MAN ROSTERS
headlines.detail: Aaron Donald is coming out of retirement to rejoin the Los Angeles Rams on a one-year, $20 million deal after all 32 teams cut down to 53-man rosters over the weekend, releasing 1,184 players leaguewide. Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes is dealing with a knee issue that has coach Andy Reid unsure of his Week 1 status.

headlines.headline: WEEK 1 HEADLINED BY BOISE STATE-OREGON AS SEASON SHIFTS INTO GEAR
headlines.detail: With Week 0 in the books, the marquee Week 1 matchup is No. 25 Boise State visiting Oregon on Saturday, with several analysts picking the Broncos to make the College Football Playoff field over the Ducks. Most of the country's Week 1 slate is set for Labor Day weekend, Sept. 4-7.
